sections.content: My original portfolio website was built using MaterializeJS, a framework that hadn't been updated for years. After realizing how outdated it had become and how it wasn't serving my needs anymore, I decided to completely redesign it. This new version leverages modern web technologies including Tailwind CSS for responsive design, DaisyUI for elegant component styling, and a custom JavaScript architecture for dynamic content loading. The result is a faster, cleaner, and more maintainable portfolio that better showcases my projects and engineering work.
